race.description: Poolwerx Wagga Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: IKON PARK (1) ran well on debut last start to finish third over this track and trip, only warming into it late. Sure to take a lot from that hitout and keeps Loy's hot-hand. Will prove tough to beat. THIRSTY FOR MORE (3) finished much closer last time when well supported at the Sapphire Coast and is open to further improvement at start three. Blinkers go on to sharpen him up and he looks the main threat. FORGIVE ME FATHER (4) never really looked likely despite the market support on debut when settling a long way back on at Canberra Acton. From a sharp stable so willing to give another look with Keatings staying in the saddle. MONNIE (9) was narrowly denied maiden success when resuming on June 29 but is yet to go on with. One more chance. TROFEO (5) is mixing his form but could make his presence felt on the quick back-up.
